column1: # Zigmacs port classification map — single source of truth for category assignment.
# Format: <lisp-name>\t<category>   (category: A B C D E F G H X)
# Categories (see PORT_CATEGORIES.md): A=pure type predicate/const, B=pure computational,
# F=GC, G=redisplay/term/windows, H=I/O/process/coding/compat, X=GUI (out of scope).
# This file is consumed by scripts/port-progress.py to compute per-category DONE counts.
# A ported DEFUN missing from this file is reported as "unclassified port" (add a line).
# Classifying UN-ported DEFUNs here too (over time) turns the per-category TOTAL estimates
# into exact, auditable counts. Lines starting with # are comments.
# --- Cat A: pure type predicates / const (ported) ---
# --- Cat H: I/O / process / coding / compat (ported) ---
